description: International Industries Limited is a manufacturer of steel and polymer pipes, tubes and fittings, incorporated in Pakistan in 1948 and quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is a core member of the Amir S. Chinoy (ASC) Group, which also includes International Steels Limited and Pakistan Cables Limited, and it operates through subsidiaries: IIL Australia Pty Limited (wholly owned), IIL Americas Inc. in Toronto, INIL Europe Limited in Ireland, and IIL Trading Pvt. Limited in Pakistan.
headOffice: 101, Beaumont Plaza, 10 Beaumont Road, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://iil.com.pk/en/page/company/about-us (company profile, group and subsidiaries), /en/page/investors/company-information (Registered Office, Chief Executive Officer) and /en/contact (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Steel pipes & tubes
products.summary: Galvanized iron pipes, pre-galvanized tubes, hollow structural sections (HSS), API line pipe, MS and black pipe, cold rolled steel tubing and fire fighting pipe.

products.name: IIL Safescaf scaffolding pipe
products.summary: A scaffolding pipe made by the company for construction use.

products.name: Stainless steel tubes
products.summary: Stainless steel tube ranges sold under the company's FORZA (400 series), COSMO (300 series) and Econic (200 series) grades.

products.name: Polymer pipes & fittings
products.summary: HDPE water pipe (Megaflo), MDPE gas pipe (Flexflo), HDPE duct and CorruDuct pipe, PPRC pipes and fittings, and UPVC pipes and fittings.

products.name: Engineering solutions
products.summary: An engineering solutions offering listed alongside the company's pipe and tube product lines.

products.name: IIL Trading
products.summary: A Pakistan-based subsidiary trading business representing brands such as Milwaukee, Fischer and Mapei.
